## Summary

Describe what happened and why it appears incorrect.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest invocation or evidence fixture that reproduces the
problem. Remove credentials, private paths, command arguments, and log content
that are not essential.

```console
$ jobman diagnose ...
```

## Expected behavior

Describe the expected deterministic or generated diagnosis.

## Actual behavior

Include safe output, exit status, and provider failure classification. Do not
paste credentials, provider response bodies, private evidence, or complete
support bundles.
